1.w: For the one directing. According to Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A Psalm. My voice [is] to God—indeed I cry out [with] my voice to God—and He has given ear to me.

2.w: In the day of my distress I sought the Lord; my hand in the night has been stretched out, and it does not slacken; my soul refuses to be comforted.

3.w: I remember God, and I groan; I meditate, and my spirit becomes faint. Selah

4.w: You hold the lids of my eyes; I am troubled, and I cannot speak.

5.w: I consider the days of old, the years of ages [past].

6.w: I remember, my song in the night; with my heart I converse, and my spirit searches.

7.w: “Will the Lord forever reject [us], and not anymore will He add to show favor?

8.w: Has His loving devotion ceased forever? Has [His] speech come to an end to generation and generation?

9.w: Or has God forgotten to show favor? Has He shut up in anger His compassion?” Selah

10.w: and I said, “I am grieved. Has it changed—the right hand of the Most High?”

11.w: I will remember the deeds of YAH; indeed, I will remember Your wonder of old.

12.w: And I have meditated on all Your work, and I put forth Your deeds.

13.w: O God, in holiness [is] Your way; what god [is] great like God?

14.w: You [are] the God doing wonders; You have made known among the peoples Your strength.

15.w: You have redeemed with [Your] arm a people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah

16.w: the waters saw You, O God, the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths trembled.

17.w: The clouds poured forth waters, the skies gave forth a voice, and Your arrows flashed back and forth.

18.w: The voice of Your thunder [was] in the whirlwind; the lightnings lit up the world; the earth trembled and shook.

19.w: Your way [was] in the sea, and Your paths in the great waters, and Your footprints were not known.

20.w: You led Your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
